speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Told you.

speaker: employment_office_assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: So, Mr. Cooper, you're looking for a job.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: A menial job. Like yours.

speaker: assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: Why, thank you for noticing. I'm Menial Employee of the Month. Do you have a particular field in mind?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I do. For thousands of years, the lowest classes of the human race have spent their lives labouring to erect monuments under the lash of their betters, until finally they dropped down and became one with the dust through which they trudged. Do you have anything like that?

speaker: assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: No.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Shouldn't you check your database?

speaker: assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: No.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You didn't really type.

speaker: assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: I didn't really have to. So, how about construction?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, that would be good! Sawing, hammering, eating out of a lunch pail as my working-class fellows and I sit perched precariously on a girder high above the metropolis.

speaker: assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: No, no. This is putting up sheetrock at a housing project in Rosemead.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I could do that. One question. What's sheetrock?

speaker: assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: Good. Yes?

speaker: assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: Moving on. How about doing deliveries for a florist?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: That seems acceptable. I don't drive.

speaker: assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: Do you have your own car?

speaker: assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: Of course you don't. Mr. Cooper, let me just ask you a question. What was your last job?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Senior theoretical particle physicist at CalTech, focusing on M theory, or, in layman's terms, string theory.

speaker: assistant#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode14
text: I see. Just give me a second. Security!
